criteria_used.name: 1. Cloud Provider, Data-Center Hosting & Proxy ASN Ownership
criteria_used.description: Flags visits originating from non-human cloud compute, VPS hosting, commercial proxy, and scanner ASNs (AWS AS14618/AS16509, Google Cloud/Mandiant AS396982, Scaleway AS12876, LeaseWeb AS395954/AS7203, M247 AS9009, HostRoyale AS203020/AS207990, Vultr/Choopa AS20473, Datacamp/code200 AS212238, IP Volume AS202425, Clouvider AS62240, LogicWeb AS64286, AltusHost AS51430, Latitude.sh AS396356, SYNLINQ AS44486) via cached/live ASN lookup.

criteria_used.name: 2. Headless Browser & Screen/Viewport Geometry Anomalies
criteria_used.description: Flags navigator.webdriver=true, headless default 800x600 physical screen resolution (often paired with larger overridden viewports like 1920x993 or 1366x768), desktop macOS UA paired with mobile 375x667 screen, mobile iPhone UA paired with 800x600/1920x993 screen, or full-page screenshot crawler viewports taller than the display (e.g., 1280x1696 on a 1920x1080 screen).

criteria_used.name: 3. Known Bot, Scanner, Truncated & Outdated/Synthetic User-Agents
criteria_used.description: Flags explicit scanner/crawler tokens ('Qlfd' Qualys tag, 'HeadlessChrome', 'bot', 'crawler'), truncated WebKit strings ('Safari/537.3' missing trailing '6'), legacy synthetic UAs ('Edge/12.246', 'Windows NT 6.1 Chrome/45'), synthetic old iOS profiles ('iPhone OS 14_0', 'iPhone OS 16_6'), and outdated headless Chromium builds (Chrome 104–149).

criteria_used.name: 4. Synchronized SERP-Scraper Pairs, Twin-Hit Rotation & Stateless Repeat IPs
criteria_used.description: Flags synchronized two-stage Google rank-checker pairs (AWS Ashburn Chrome/124 hit followed 31–66s later by a LeaseWeb/M247 Chrome/149 hit on the exact same deep route), sub-second/multi-OS UA rotation on the same distinct_id, cross-domain scanner IPs hitting both JunkHaulHQ.com and B2BFeeAudit.com root '/', and repeat IPs minting fresh stateless distinct_ids per hit.

criteria_used.name: 5. Lack of Human Engagement Signals (Zero Scroll, No Pageleave/Dwell, Zero Clicks)
criteria_used.description: Evaluates session-level interaction across all PostHog events: requires >0% scroll depth, meaningful dwell time (>=5s on $pageleave), multi-page navigation, or interactive events (calculator/estimator inputs, CTA clicks, citation clicks). Stateless single-page hits with 0% scroll, no $pageleave (or <1s bounce), and 0 clicks are flagged.
